description: This Java class acts as a temporary static container for a ConfigurationDomainService, providing static access methods for certain configuration properties, primarily used as a workaround during code refactoring or cleanup processes.

classes.name: TemporaryConfigurationServiceContainer
classes.description: A Spring-managed component that provides static access to configuration services for temporary or transitional purposes. Implements InitializingBean to set a static reference upon initialization.

methods.name: isExternalIdAutoGenerationEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether external ID auto-generation is enabled, delegated to the underlying ConfigurationDomainService.

methods.name: getAccrualDateConfigForCharge
methods.description: Retrieves the accrual date configuration for charges from the underlying ConfigurationDomainService.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the static reference to the ConfigurationDomainService after dependency injection.
